data.name: Amalraana
data.gender_notes: Amalraana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'amala' meaning 'to trust, rely'. This name signifies one who places her trust in Allah, relying on His infinite wisdom and mercy. The name Amalraana carries the meaning “Hope, Trust, Reliance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Amalraana usually hope their child will grow to embody hope, trust, reliance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes faith and trust in Allah.
data.etymology: Amalraana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Hope, Trust, Reliance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amalraana total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
